p.i: Diuósque supra creditos Omnes timendus vnicus. Idola nanque vana sunt Dij profani Gentium, At nostER hic Deus potens, Cœlum solúmque condidit. Hunc in suo sacrario Cingit refulgens gloria, Circunstat ambiens decor, Robúrque mumit vndique. Adeste gentes vndique, Adeste & isti cedite Huic gloriam vos numini, Huic omne robur cedite.
Audite gentes, Deus adest, Quo rege firmus permanens, Rectisque rectus legibus Orbis vigebit integer.
Deum canite quo nil melius aut pulchrius, Vltrò Iacobum qui suum allegit sibi, Et Israelem ceu peculium fouet.
Vnus iste maximus Plenus vnus roboris, Gnarus vnus omnium. Iste pressos subleuat, Iste perdit impios.

main_text.p: Quum autem quàm latè pateat Dei prouidentia consideramus, quæ sine exceptione ab vno mundi extremo ad aliud extremum pertingit,

page.notes: Some ink smudges in the verse (e.g. "mumit", "Circunstat" initial) may be damaged; "mumit" read as printed with a blot. Reading of "nostER" in line 5 is doubtful and was copied as printed; the initial letter of "Circunstat" is partly obscured. Verse lines are set in italic with short indents, transcribed as separate lines within stanza paragraphs.
